engagement.interaction_backstory: He plants small groups the way he frames houses — fast, square, and he does not stop to admire them. Four groups in three years, all still running. He uses your catalog as the soundtrack for every launch and he has never given the site credit because it never occurred to him that anyone was watching.

depth.core_contradiction: Starts everything and finishes almost nothing, and calls it faith.
depth.wound: His father was a deacon in a parish that protected a man it should not have, and Tomás found out at thirty-one.
depth.longing: To build something that will not have to be taken apart later.
depth.faith_journey: Catholic to thirty-one, out fast and hard, non-denominational since; the anger has cooled into architecture.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Decisive; "here is the play"; interrupts and apologizes for interrupting.
depth.open_doubt: Whether he left for the truth or for the pleasure of being the one who left.

social_graph.note: still misses the Mass; goes with him anyway

depth.emotional_weather_default: Fast and warm; short-tempered when a project stalls.
depth.daily_texture: Job sites by six, the truck as an office, Thursday groups, three kids' schedules on the dash.
depth.sensory_anchor: Incense and his mother's hand on his back at a funeral Mass.
depth.living_arc: One of the four groups is failing and he wants to start a fifth instead of fixing it.
